comments.author: Ming Mei
comments.body:
If I add attack prevention net & repair support for optional skill and leave heavy bombing as original skill I can get a build with:
1200 dura
41 armour
15 turn (-1 from cargo)
12 wave resist
88 sailors
900 cargo (roughly)
Looks like it has enough speed and cargo to trade (espeically suited to fleets with faster tow leader) and is unlikely to be sinked by pirate's cannons BUT will I die easily in melee with just 88 crew? I have attack prevention net and I intend to use bell of withdrawal unless pirates have annoying item-block aide.

comments.body:
In the real world.... you know we're playing a game right? I will freely admit I have never had one of these but I have talked to two people who have used them. One was a pirate-type and that person said it's great "for what I use it for". The other said the same thing you say, it's trying to do a little of everything so it can't really do anything.

Here's the thing though, he improved it and played around with it and ended up being impressed. It has decent speed in open sea and is surprisingly agile with good accelleration in a battle situation, unlike the clippers used for trade which are lumbering hulks once battle begins.

So in fact these are better at evading pirate activity once they have been caught and battle commences.
